title: PI Permission System Configuration
description: Unified config file combining runtime knobs and flat permission policy for pi-permission-system.
markdownDescription:
Unified config file combining runtime knobs and flat permission policy for [pi-permission-system](https://github.com/gotgenes/pi-permission-system).

Place at `~/.pi/agent/extensions/pi-permission-system/config.json` (global) or `<project>/.pi/extensions/pi-permission-system/config.json` (project).

$schema.description: JSON Schema URI for editor autocomplete and validation.

debugLog.description: Write verbose permission-system diagnostics to the extension logs directory.
debugLog.markdownDescription: Write verbose permission-system diagnostics to `logs/pi-permission-system-debug.jsonl` under the extension config directory.

permissionReviewLog.description: Write permission request and decision audit events to the extension logs directory.
permissionReviewLog.markdownDescription: Write permission request and decision audit events to `logs/pi-permission-system-permission-review.jsonl` under the extension config directory.

yoloMode.description: Auto-approve ask-state permission checks, including subagent approval forwarding.
yoloMode.markdownDescription:
Auto-approve `ask`-state permission checks, including subagent approval forwarding.

⚠️ **Use with caution** — this disables all interactive confirmation prompts.

toolInputPreviewMaxLength.description: Maximum character length of the inline-JSON tool-input preview shown in permission prompts. Omit to use the default (200). Set to a large value to disable truncation.
toolInputPreviewMaxLength.markdownDescription:
Maximum character length of the inline-JSON tool-input preview shown in permission prompts.

Omit to use the default (200). Set to a large value (e.g. `10000`) to effectively disable truncation and see the full input.

toolTextSummaryMaxLength.description: Maximum character length of inline pattern/path summaries (e.g. grep patterns, find globs, ls paths) in permission prompts. Omit to use the default (80).
toolTextSummaryMaxLength.markdownDescription:
Maximum character length of inline pattern/path summaries (e.g. grep patterns, find globs, ls paths) shown in permission prompts.

Omit to use the default (80). Increase this when working with long regexes or deep paths that are being cut off.

allowLocalEdits.description: Auto-approve the tool-level permission check for edit and write when the target path is inside the current working directory. Path and external_directory gates and PreToolUse hooks still apply.
allowLocalEdits.markdownDescription:
Auto-approve the tool-level permission check for `edit` and `write` when the target path resolves inside the current working directory.

The override applies only to the final tool permission gate. Cross-cutting `path` and `external_directory` gates run earlier and can still block in-CWD edits, and PreToolUse hooks run after the override and can still `deny` or `ask`.

allowWebAccess.description: Auto-approve web_search and get_search_content tool calls, and enable interactive per-domain prompts for fetch_content.
allowWebAccess.markdownDescription:
Auto-approve `web_search` and `get_search_content` tool calls, and enable the per-domain confirmation dialog for `fetch_content`.

When enabled and Pi has a UI, denied `fetch_content` calls trigger an interactive prompt that offers four outcomes: approve once, approve and persist the domain to `allowedFetchDomains`, approve the domain for the current session only, or deny.

allowedFetchDomains.description: Lowercase hostnames for which fetch_content is auto-approved when allowWebAccess is enabled.
allowedFetchDomains.markdownDescription:
Lowercase hostnames for which `fetch_content` is auto-approved when `allowWebAccess` is enabled.

Merged across scopes by union (lowercased + deduplicated). Entries are normally added via the interactive `fetch_content` prompt's "always allow" action, but can also be set directly here.

hooks.description: Claude-Code-compatible PreToolUse hooks. Only the global config contributes hooks; project config and agent frontmatter do not contribute or override them.
hooks.markdownDescription:
Claude-Code-compatible `PreToolUse` hooks.

Each matcher's `matcher` field is a regex compiled as `^(?:matcher)$` against the Claude-Code-style tool name (e.g. `Bash`, `Edit`, `mcp__server__tool`). The optional `if` clause supplies a `Tool(pattern)` filter over the tool-specific input field.

For each matching command, the extension spawns `sh -c command.command` with a JSON payload on stdin. Exit 0 + a valid JSON `hookSpecificOutput.permissionDecision` returns that decision; exit 2 → deny (stderr becomes the reason); other exits and empty/invalid output defer to the normal permission gates. The `updatedInput` and `additionalContext` fields are accepted but not currently honored.

Only configurable at the **global** scope; project and per-agent scopes do not contribute hooks.

PreToolUse.description: Matchers evaluated before each tool call.

piInfrastructureReadPaths.description: Additional directories to auto-allow for reads as Pi infrastructure, bypassing the external_directory gate. Supports ~ expansion and wildcard patterns (* and ?).
piInfrastructureReadPaths.markdownDescription:
Additional directories to auto-allow for reads as Pi infrastructure, bypassing the `external_directory` gate.

The extension auto-discovers the global node_modules root (walks up from the extension's install path; falls back to `npm root -g` from a dev checkout), `agentDir`, `agentDir/git`, and project-local `.pi/npm/` and `.pi/git/`. Add entries here for edge cases where auto-discovery is insufficient (e.g. custom `npmCommand` pointing to pnpm).

Supports `~`/`$HOME` expansion. Entries may be plain directory prefixes or wildcard patterns using `*` (matches any characters, including `/`) and `?` (matches exactly one character). `**` and `*` are equivalent — both cross directory boundaries.

permission.description: Flat permission policy. Each key is a surface name; values are a PermissionState string (catch-all) or a pattern→action map.
permission.markdownDescription:
Flat permission policy.

Each top-level key is a surface name:
- `"*"` — universal fallback (replaces `defaultPolicy.tools` from the legacy format)
- Tool names (`read`, `write`, `bash`, `mcp`, `skill`, `external_directory`, `path`, etc.)

A **string** value is shorthand for `{ "*": action }` (surface-level catch-all).
An **object** value maps wildcard patterns to actions — last matching pattern wins.

For path-bearing tools (`read`, `write`, `edit`, `find`, `grep`, `ls`), patterns are matched against the file path from `input.path`. For example, `"read": { "*": "allow", "*.env": "deny" }` allows reads but denies `.env` files.

The `path` surface is a cross-cutting gate that applies to **all** file access — both Pi tools and bash commands. A `path` deny cannot be overridden by a per-tool allow. Use it to protect sensitive files (`.env`, `~/.ssh/*`) from all tools at once.

**Merge order (lowest → highest precedence):** global config → project config → global agent frontmatter → project agent frontmatter.

propertyNames.description: A surface name or the universal fallback key '*'.

preToolUseMatcher.description: A regex matcher and its associated hook commands.

matcher.description: Regex source compiled as ^(?:matcher)$ against the Claude-Code-style tool name (e.g. 'Bash', 'Edit', 'mcp__server__.*').

hooks.description: Hook commands run sequentially when the matcher matches.

type.description: Always 'command' — only shell commands are supported today.

command.description: Shell command to execute via `sh -c`. Receives the PreToolUse JSON payload on stdin.

if.description: Optional Tool(pattern) clause that filters by the tool-specific input field (Bash→command, Read/Write/Edit→file_path, Grep→path|pattern, Glob→pattern).

permissionState.description: A permission decision: allow (permit silently), deny (block with error), or ask (prompt the user for confirmation).

oneOf.description: Permit the action silently with no user interaction.
Block the action with an error message. The agent is told not to retry.
Prompt the user for confirmation via the interactive UI before proceeding.

permissionMap.description: A map of wildcard patterns to permission states. Last matching pattern wins.
permissionMap.markdownDescription:
A map of wildcard patterns to permission states.

Use `*` for wildcard matching. When multiple patterns match, the **last matching rule wins** — put broad catch-alls first and specific overrides after them.

Pattern keys support home directory expansion:
- `~/path` or `$HOME/path` — expanded to the OS home directory at match time.
- `~` or `$HOME` alone — expands to the home directory itself.

The stored pattern is always shown in logs and approval dialogs as written (e.g. `~/dev/*`).

propertyNames.description: A non-empty pattern string. Use * for wildcard matching. Prefix with ~/ or $HOME/ for home-relative paths.
